title: Brazilian Chorizo Casserole with Quaint Toppings
description: A hearty casserole filled with spicy chorizo, paired with a delightful quaint topping for a unique twist.

ingredients.name: Chorizo
ingredients.notes: Slice chorizo into 1/4 inch thick rounds

ingredients.name: Quaint Toppings (Fluffy Cheese and Brazilian Chopped Herbs)
ingredients.notes: Mix together fluffy cheese and chopped Brazilian herbs

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing bread and casserole pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together chorizo, casserole, olive oil, salt, pepper, and Brazilian spice blend.
In a separate bowl, mix together quaint toppings (fluffy cheese and Brazilian chopped herbs).
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of bread pieces.
Add the chorizo and casserole mixture on top of the bread layer.
Sprinkle quaint toppings on top of the chorizo layer.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of bread on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
